metadata.executor: Agent-tool subagents, one per eval, each pointed at a copy of fixtures/<id>/inputs as its working directory, with SKILL.md loaded and no browser, web, calendar, email, or connector access
metadata.notes: Graded against each trial's written report and its final reply. Eval 2, 4, and 6 trials stop to ask the user, as the skill directs, so their expectations are checked against the draft and question in the reply. All six with-skill evals were rerun after event emojis and scripts/game_minutes.py were added; every minute in these runs comes from the script. Eval 6 was rerun after Step 2 stopped asking for a missing opponent roster; it now writes 'No opponent roster' and says so in the reply. Evals 1, 3, 5, and 6 were rerun after photos moved to their own Photos section with italic captions, the Rosters heading was dropped, player names were unbolded, and a note's written minute was ranked above its own timestamp; evals 2 and 4 write no report and carry over. Eval 6 expects the written 77'. The recording check (reading jersey numbers from video) is not exercised: trials have no recording access. Evals 1, 3, and 6 were rerun after kickoff lines moved to the minutes already played (0', 45', 90', 105'); eval 3 checks this. In that rerun, eval 6 quoted the 'FT!!! 1-0 semis' full-time note under Match Observations, which its expectation counts as a miss; the earlier run wrote 'No observations'.

expectations.text: scoresheet.md exists, has no '## Rosters' heading, and its sections appear in this order: '# Match Report: Argentina vs. France', '## Match Details', '### Argentina', '### France', '## Significant Events', '## Photos', '## Match Observations', '## Post-Match Commentary', '## Recording'.
expectations.evidence: Sections in the listed order; no '## Rosters' heading.

expectations.text: Match Details give Date 2022-12-18, a Start Time of 18:00 with the time zone (AST or UTC+3), Venue Lusail Stadium with its location, and Competition as a Markdown link to the fifa.com Qatar 2022 page.
expectations.evidence: 2022-12-18, 18:00 AST (UTC+3), Lusail Stadium, Lusail, Qatar, fifa.com link.

expectations.text: Both rosters are sorted by jersey number with Starter entries before Substitute entries; the Argentina starters are exactly #3, #7, #9, #10, #11, #13, #19, #20, #23, #24, #26 and the France starters are exactly #1, #4, #5, #7, #8, #9, #10, #11, #14, #18, #22.
expectations.evidence: Starters then substitutes, each by number; starter sets match exactly.

expectations.text: Roster lines bold only the jersey number, as in '- **#10** Lionel Messi (FWD) - Starter', and each team ends with a Coach line: Lionel Scaloni for Argentina, Didier Deschamps for France.
expectations.evidence: Only numbers bold; Coach lines Lionel Scaloni and Didier Deschamps.

expectations.text: Significant Events has Goal (penalty) Lionel Messi #10 at 23', Goal Ángel Di María #11 assisted by Alexis Mac Allister #20 at 36', and both France substitutions (Thuram #26 for Giroud #9, Kolo Muani #12 for Dembélé #11) at 41'.
expectations.evidence: 23' Messi penalty, 36' Di María (Mac Allister), 41' Thuram/Giroud and Kolo Muani/Dembélé.

expectations.text: Halftime is at 45+8', the Rabiot yellow card at 55', Acuña for Di María at 64', both France substitutions at 71', Mbappé's penalty at 80', Mbappé's goal assisted by Thuram at 81', and Thuram's yellow card at 87'.

End of regulation is at 90+8', Montiel for Molina at 91', Paredes for De Paul at 102', extra-time halftime at 105+1', Messi's goal at 108', Mbappé's penalty at 118', Dybala for Tagliafico at 120+1', and end of extra time at 120+3'. No event uses a minute counted from the start of its period (such as 10' for the Rabiot card).

The shootout is listed in kick order (Mbappé scored, Messi scored, Coman saved, Dybala scored, Tchouaméni missed, Paredes scored, Kolo Muani scored, Montiel scored) without game minutes, and the final line records the 3-3 draw with Argentina winning 4-2 on penalties.
expectations.evidence: Eight kicks in order without minutes; 'Game over (Argentina 3-3 France, Argentina win 4-2 on penalties)'.

expectations.text: All three photos appear in the '## Photos' section after Significant Events, not as list items and not in Significant Events: each is the image (line ending in a backslash, caption as alt text) followed by '📷 **<minute>** - *<caption>*', with one blank line between photos, with paths that resolve from scoresheet.md, in chronological order: IMG_4101 (Pre-match), IMG_4133 (108'), IMG_4170 (Post-match); captions describe what each shows (teams walking out, Messi celebrating, the trophy lift).
expectations.evidence: Photos section: IMG_4101 Pre-match, IMG_4133 108', IMG_4170 Post-match, backslash lines, italic captions, paths resolve.

expectations.text: The 108' goal line links to the YouTube video with a t value of 8850 seconds (8820 to 8880 accepted), computed from the 17:58:00 stream start.
expectations.evidence: 108' goal link t=8850.

expectations.text: Match Observations contains the observation from the notes, Post-Match Commentary states there are no notes (rather than placeholder text), and Recording is a single line in the form [YouTube | Argentina vs. France](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WCF2022demo).
expectations.evidence: Observation quoted; 'No notes'; '[YouTube | Argentina vs. France](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WCF2022demo)'.
